# Asia Chip Supply Tightens, Prices Keep Rising  
**Bottom line:** Supply risk sits at 69 / 100 and price trend at 84 / 100, so push for price locks on high‑risk logic parts while keeping normal cadence for well‑stocked MOSFETs.

## What changed
- Market supply risk edged down 0.1 point to **69.2** and price trend held steady at **84.2** (confidence 83 %)[​1]​.  
- TSMC foundry loading surged +50.9 % YoY, tightening supply across advanced logic and memory segments[​3]​.  
- Global chip sales jumped **+146.1 % YoY** in Aug 2026, driving both demand‑side price pressure and tighter supply[​2]​.

## Featured part: IPB017N10N5ATMA1
- Lead time **14 weeks** with **27,211** units in channel stock (≈17.7 weeks of coverage)[​data​].  
- Price $5.56 / unit (qty 1) and $2.51 / unit (qty 1k) – a clear volume discount[​data​].  
- Origin **Austria**, tariff **0 %** (no surcharge posted)[​data​].  
- **Call:** “Lock pricing (no need to buy ahead)” – 65 % chance prices rise in 3 months but supply is adequate, so fix price now and keep normal ordering cadence[​data​].


## Segment board
- Processors & advanced logic – **Rising** (69.4, 0.0), **Rising** price 82.6, High confidence  
- Memory (DRAM/NAND/HBM) – **Elevated** (71.3, –0.1), **Rising** price 84.3, High confidence  
- Analog & power management – **Rising** (65.5, 0.0), **Rising** price 83.1, High confidence  
- Microcontrollers & embedded – **Rising** (66.2, –0.1), **Rising** price 82.0, High confidence  
- Power discretes (MOSFET/IGBT/SiC/GaN) – **Rising** (62.2, –0.1), **Rising** price 82.3, High confidence  

## Your BOM watchlist
- **10M08SAE144C8G** – lead time **52 weeks** vs 12‑week norm, supply risk **83** (logic).  
- **IS25LP128-JBLE** – lead time **52 weeks**, supply risk **83** (memory).  
- **LCMXO2-1200HC-4TG100C** – lead time **52.1 weeks**, supply risk **83** (logic).  
- **XC7A35T-1CSG324C** – lead time **52 weeks**, supply risk **83** (logic).  
- **MT25QL128ABA1EW9-0SIT** – lead time **52.1 weeks**, supply risk **82.7** (memory).

## Outlook
- **Chip prices, next 3 mo:** 66 % chance of rise, expected **+2.17 %** (80 % range –9.57 % to +13.91 %); model‑tested edge.  
- **Chip prices, next 6 mo:** 52 % chance of rise, expected **+4.34 %** (baseline trend‑following).  
- **Fab utilization, next 3 mo:** 63 % chance utilization climbs, expected **+1.82 pts** (baseline).  
- **Fab utilization, next 6 mo:** 60 % chance utilization climbs, expected **+3.64 pts** (baseline).  

## Negotiation angle
1. **Lock‑in pricing** for the five watchlist parts with 52‑week lead times; cite the 65 % 3‑month price‑rise probability and the extreme lead‑time gap.  
2. Request **volume‑based discounts** on the featured MOSFET (IPB017N10N5ATMA1) now that supply is neutral and a lock‑pricing call is recommended.  
3. Push suppliers to **share updated fab utilization forecasts**; a 1.8‑point uptick in utilization over three months signals tighter capacity, useful leverage for price concessions.
